3: A Python package that computes finite-temperature binary phase diagrams from 0 K crystal structures and an MLIP. Solid phases are treated with the quasi-harmonic approximation (QHA) or calphy thermodynamic integration (TI), the liquid phase with calphy TI, and configurational entropy with ideal mixing, sublattice and thermal-defect models or CE+MC; the T–x diagram is obtained by the lower convex hull of a free-energy table on a common reference. Stages 01–07 can be run as an AiiDA WorkChain.
5: Stages 01–07 are connected end to end. T–x diagrams were computed for Al–Li (ACE and 6 universal MLIPs), Ni–Al (EAM, B2 and L1₂ with composition width) and Ag–Cu (EAM, eutectic and miscibility gap).
6: Melting points are set by the cell size of the solid TI. 256-atom Frenkel–Ladd is about 7 meV/atom too low and puts melting points 50–70 K too high. With 2,000 atoms or more, Ag 1278, Cu 1326, Al 1040, Ni 1703 and B2 1808 K agree within 2–30 K with the potential authors' two-phase coexistence MD.
7: Solubility limits agree between routes. The fcc solvus of Ag–Cu from ideal mixing + Redlich–Kister interpolation (route A) and from direct semi-grand-canonical MC (route B) agree within 0.015 at 800–900 K. CE+MC contains no vibrations and does not reproduce the temperature dependence.
8: Most of the error in the computed phase diagrams comes from the potential. The ACE Al–Li eutectic is about 110 K below experiment, and the Ni–Al EAM does not give the Al-side B2 width (its vacancy formation energy is 0.4–0.5 eV above DFT). These are not problems on the workflow side.
9: Differences between universal MLIPs appear in the vibrations and the liquid, not at 0 K. The 0 K formation energies of 12 MLIPs nearly agree, but models with soft phonons overstabilise the solid. The eutectic and solubility limit closest to experiment come from SevenNet-MF-ompa (850–860 K, 0.132), whose liquid runs cost 21 times ACE. The Al melting point of NequIP-OAM-M, 931 K, agrees with experiment (933.5 K), with the eutectic at 800–810 K (one liquid run costs about 5 times ACE). MatterSim-v1-5M, added on 11-05, gives Al melting at 996 K and the eutectic at 720–730 K (1M: 762 K, eutectic below 700 K); NequIP-OAM-S has the softest fcc Al phonons (S(300 K) 4.86 k_B) and Al does not melt up to 900 K. DPA4-Plus-OMat24 (deepmd-kit 3.2.0, OMat24 only), added on 11-10, gives Al 989 K, eutectic 750–760 K and solubility limit 0.162, close to GRACE-2L-OMAT. The κ_SRME of Matbench Discovery correlates with the results; F1 does not.
10: Ni–Al and Ag–Cu were also computed with 3 MLIPs (10-30 to 11-06, Fig. 10). With QHA solids the melting points of universal MLIPs are off by several hundred K (QHA is 33–65 meV/atom below TI for alloy cells), so every cell was treated by solid TI with 2,000 atoms or more. GRACE-1L Ni–Al is close to experiment: B2 1790–1800 K, L1₂ peritectic 1590–1620 K, Ni₂Al₃ 1370–1380 K, NiAl₃ 1110–1120 K. In Ag–Cu all three put the Ag melting point 250–300 K too low and shift the eutectic toward the Ag side.
11: Checked against the literature database ORCHID (11-03). orchid_compare.py compares the stage-07 output of every run, with the same metrics (phase recall S, temperature difference of invariant reactions), against the experimental invariant-reaction temperatures and the interior points of phase regions of assessed diagrams in ORCHID v2026.10 ([Arroyave2026], 1,321 papers, 73,542 evidence records). Al–Li eutectic (ORCHID median 872 K): NequIP-OAM-M −67, SevenNet-MF-ompa −17, SevenNet-0 +63 K; Ni–Al B2+L1₂+liquid (1642 K): GRACE-1L −7 K. The Ag–Cu eutectic (1053 K) lies below the 1100 K grid lower limit of every run and cannot be checked.
12: The CALPHAD-side reference was aligned (11-04). The SGTE assessments in ORCHID-Diagrams (Al–Li 7, Al–Ni 12, Ag–Cu 6; a few K between assessments) were overlaid on the T–x diagrams of all MLIPs (Fig. 8). Assessing Al–Li with ESPEI from ORCHID data alone gives the eutectic (855 K) but leaves the Li side undetermined (Fig. 9). The MLIP-based Pt–Rh TDB ([Saengdeejing2026]) was organised from the same viewpoint.
13: Computing infrastructure. Two GPUs and two CPU hosts are used selectively from AiiDA. The LAMMPS builds and bug fixes (SevenNet virial, MACE atom map) needed to run GRACE, SevenNet and MACE on the GPU with calphy are done. Single precision was accurate enough for TI.
